powerId.label: Power sensor (watt)
powerId.help: ioBroker data point providing the current power draw in watts

powerThreshold.label: Power-on threshold (W)
powerThreshold.help: Power level from which the device is considered running. Recommended: 10W for all device types

offDelayMin.label: Off delay (min)
offDelayMin.help: How long power must stay below the threshold before the cycle ends. Recommended: washing machine 5 min · dryer 8 min · dishwasher 8 min · washer-dryer 10 min

startEnergyThreshold.label: Start energy gate (Wh)
startEnergyThreshold.help: Minimum energy after start before the cycle is counted (prevents false starts). Recommended: washing machine 2 Wh · dryer 5 Wh · washer-dryer 5 Wh

durationTolerance.label: Duration tolerance (0.05–0.5)
durationTolerance.help: How much the run time may deviate from the profile. 0.2 = ±20%

matchIntervalMin.label: Matching interval (min)
matchIntervalMin.help: How often the program is matched. Recommended: 5 min for all device types

matchPersist.label: Match confirmations (count)
matchPersist.help: How many times in a row the same program must be detected. 3 = reliable · 2 = faster

autoConfirmThreshold.label: Auto-confirm from confidence (%)
autoConfirmThreshold.help: From this confidence level the cycle is confirmed automatically. 0 = disabled · 85 = recommended

instantConfirmThreshold.label: Instant adoption from confidence (%)
instantConfirmThreshold.help: During a running cycle: if the live preview repeatedly (2x) shows at least this confidence, the program is adopted immediately instead of waiting for the normal, slower detection.

matchThreshold.label: Program detection threshold (%)
matchThreshold.help: From this confidence a program counts as detected (and is shown). Below it, it stays 'detecting...'. 55 = recommended

notifyOnProbable.label: Notify also for probable program
notifyOnProbable.help: Send a Telegram update as soon as a program is detected - even if confidence is below the auto-confirm threshold

ignoreAntiKnitter.label: Ignore anti-crease phase
ignoreAntiKnitter.help: ON: cycle ends immediately at the beep, the anti-crease phase is ignored (simple, sufficient for most dryers). OFF: the adapter actively tries to detect when the cycle is really finished across the anti-crease phase (needs a saved reference pattern under 'Programs').
